vinatā.cp: fem. the mother of the Garuda race.
vinatā.p: [Vi+na+ta] (thī) CL=9 Vino pakkhino namanti yaṃ vinatā. Dhāna,ṭī.628. Vinatā-saṃ. Vinayā-prā.] (1) mother of Gaḷuna (mythical King of birds and also the enemy of dragon. (2) river named Vinatā. (3) queen named Vinatā.
pn: Vinatā. A river, probably in Himavā (Ap.i.295, etc.). In a former birth Vanavaccha lived there as a tortoise (Thag-a.i.58). Nanda also lived there. Thag-a.i.276.
